_comment: Replay persistence of a checkerboard form-up's line index (issue 1484). Six understrength Infantry cohorts spawn in a ragged, alternating two-height clump in the lower-left of the field, get box-selected, and are then formed up with a LEFT-TO-RIGHT checkerboard drag well above them, so the whole force advances north into a quincunx: three cohorts on the front line and three offset behind them. That gesture is the one that stamps Unit.line_index (SelectionManager._checkerboard_slices tags each slice's line, Battle.enqueue_form_up carries it on the order, Battle._apply_order_cmd writes it onto the unit), and the drain that records the order into the replay stream is exactly what this issue fixes -- Replay.record_order now carries the line index, so a saved recording of THIS deploy replays with the same front/reserve split instead of silently dropping it. The line index still has no render path of its own (nothing reads is_front_line()/is_reserve_line() yet -- the flank-vulnerability and withdrawal mechanics that will are a later phase), so the persistence itself is verified by test/unit/test_replay.gd's round-trip and back-compat cases, not by anything visible in this clip; what the clip shows is the live deploy whose line assignments the fix preserves, recorded through the real recording call site. Deliberately not a copy of the issue-819 clip: different unit type (Infantry, not Spearmen), six units instead of four, a staggered rather than evenly-spaced spawn, a south-to-north advance instead of north-to-south, its own seed, and its own camera framing. drill:true (no team 1) since this is a pure maneuver demo. Static camera wide enough to hold both the ragged start and the settled quincunx.
